races.paceDynamic: Top Biller will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with Alashos, Anglesey Lad, Grand Citadel, Bated Breeze, Apple's Angel and Dreambird Dolly likely to race prominently behind. With 25 runners and limited early pace, Top Biller can dictate terms and set a steady gallop without pressure. The large field will bunch up behind the modest early pace, creating a cavalry charge finish where hold-up horses with tactical speed can weave through traffic. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Top Biller sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows closers to wind up from the back while prominent runners hit a wall. Hold-up horses like Von Krolock and Rovinia can time their runs perfectly through the pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can secure good positions without over-racing
scenarios.body: Alashos and Grand Citadel can stalk the modest pace and kick clear before the hold-up brigade arrives. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Top Biller gets very soft fractions and the field is too far back
scenarios.body: The leader maintains a sustainable rhythm and holds off late challengers who leave their runs too late. The 25-runner field creates traffic problems that aid the front runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and it becomes a pure sprint
scenarios.body: The race turns into a bunched sprint where tactical speed matters most and traffic causes major interference. Horses drawn poorly or caught wide suffer most.

races.paceDynamic: Havana Joy, Gone Rogue, and King Of War will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with potential support from prominently-raced Shaw Park and Starsong. The strong pace will test stamina reserves over this 7f trip on Brighton's stiff finish. With 19 runners and confirmed pace-setters, the leaders face pressure throughout while the hold-up brigade gets ideal conditions. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can finish fastest when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a genuine pace throughout the first 5f
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the leaders' stamina reserves, setting up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Von Krolock and Simply Blue can capitalize on their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If Gone Rogue or King Of War manage to dictate more sensible fractions
scenarios.body: The more controlled tempo allows prominent racers to stay closer to the pace without over-exerting, giving Shaw Park and Starsong better chances to kick clear. The hold-up horses still benefit but face stiffer competition from those closer to the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel Fallout
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Joy and Gone Rogue engage in a speed duel through the first half
scenarios.body: Both leaders compromise their finishing kicks, creating opportunities for the second wave of prominent racers and patient closers alike. Mart and Dakota Power can capitalize on better positioning without the extreme early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survival
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters finds an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: King Of War or Gone Rogue could steal a march if they avoid the early battle, maintaining enough energy to resist the inevitable late challenge. However, the 19-runner field makes this scenario less likely.
